dict.string: SUBQUERY(extensionItems, $e, SUBQUERY($e.attachments, $a, ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.image" OR ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "com.adobe.pdf" OR ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.plain-text").@count >= 1 AND SUBQUERY($e.attachments, $a, ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.image").@count <= 10 AND SUBQUERY($e.attachments, $a, ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "com.adobe.pdf").@count <= 1).@count >= 1
